entry.name: D6 - PowerShell Spawning Discovery or Scheduling Tool (T1059.001)
entry.author: nobody

content.description: Sysmon EventID 1 where ParentImage is powershell.exe and the child is net.exe/net1.exe/schtasks.exe. Deliberately CROSS-CUTTING (unlike D1-D5, which each target one capture/technique): this parent-child pattern is the common enabling behavior (PowerShell, ATT&CK T1059.001) behind 3 of the 5 Empire captures. Verified: fires on all 3 intended captures (empire_schtasks_creation_standard_user, empire_shell_net_localgroup_administrators, empire_shell_net_local_users), 0 false positives against the benign baseline (zero PowerShell-parented process creations of any kind in that capture window).
